package.name: omni_mcu
package.description: omni-robot (design.md 30): the MCU link's Python side, no ROS: protocol.py (COBS + CRC frames, CMD / STATE / IMU, time sync) mirrors firmware/lib/omni_fw/protocol.h, and clock_sync.py; the sim and the console use them. The robot's mcu_link node is omni_cpp's (C++).
